summary: Columbia County lookout site: a March 1935 Forest Log note says Camp Boyington set up a second lookout on Tunnel Mountain. No later record found.

events.note: Secondary lookout listed as already established by Camp Boyington in a March 1935 Forest Log note; no build date is given and the note does not describe the structure

evidence.supports: secondary lookout set up on Tunnel Mountain by Camp Boyington, reported March 1935
evidence.quote: March 1935: An accomplishment of the Camp Boyington since its establishment in the late Fall of 1933 includes the establishment of a secondary lookout on Tunnel Mountain. (The Forest Log)

evidence.supports: page lists Tunnel Mountain under Columbia County
agency named as Oregon Department of Forestry
Columbia County has had seven peaks with fire lookout towers
evidence.quote: Columbia County has had seven different peaks with fire lookout towers

notes_for_editor: Only one dated source for this lookout: a March 1935 Forest Log note saying Camp Boyington set up a secondary lookout on Tunnel Mountain. Nothing found on design, height, staffing, use after 1935, fate, or the site today, so status stays unknown and no visit facts are given. Camp Boyington context (CCC camp, location near Olney or Astoria) came only from search snippets and a livingnewdeal.org page that returned 403; it is left out. The brief's coordinates (46.08594, -123.3429) were not checked against a source. The 1935 note reports the lookout as established; it does not give a build date beyond that.
